newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool indicator steady on 573c/kg.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool indicator steady on 573c/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market eastern indicator remained steady on 573 cents a kg clean at sales in Newcastle and Melbourne on Wednesday, Wool International (WI) said.
Merino fleece prices were mixed. The 19 micron indicator was 0.5 percent cheaper but 20m slightly dearer.
The 21/22m categories were slightly cheaper, 23/24m up to 1.0 percent cheaper, 25m 0.5 percent dearer and 26m 1.0 percent dearer, WI said.
In merino skirtings, 19/20/21m were 1.0 percent cheaper and 22m slightly cheaper.
In crossbreds, 27/28m were slightly cheaper, 29m 1.0 percent dearer and 30/31m 0.5 percent cheaper.
In cardings, lambs were slightly cheaper and locks and crutchings fully firm.
WI said Italian, Taiwanese, Japanese and Chinese interests were principal buyers with support from Western Europe.
Of 20,673 bales offered, 6.9 percent were passed in.
Sales continue on Thursday in Newcastle, Melbourne and Fremantle with about 34,200 bales to be offered.
